definitions.explanation: The point or area where two lines, edges, or surfaces meet.

examples.english: To put it in the corner of the room.

examples.japanese: {角|すみ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{角|すみ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I searched from corner to corner.
I placed flowers in the corner of the desk.
To read a book in a quiet nook.
I sat in a corner of the shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片|かた}{隅|すみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{静|しず}かに→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live quietly in a corner of the world.

notes:
{角|すみ} refers to an interior corner or secluded spot.

KANJI NOTE:
Often written as {隅|すみ} (different kanji, same meaning for corner).

READINGS OF 角:
- {角|すみ}: interior corner (of room, page, etc.)
- {角|かど}: exterior corner (of street, building), angle
- {角|つの}: horn (of animal)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {部屋|へや}の{隅|すみ}: corner of a room
- {隅々|すみずみ}: every corner, every nook and cranny
- {隅|すみ}に{置|お}けない: not to be taken lightly, impressive
- {片|かた}{隅|すみ}: a corner, one corner

{角|すみ} VS {角|かど}:
すみ is for interior corners (inside); かど is for exterior corners (outside).
